title: Review of c28's kernel-drive ringswim: Supported on fresh seed 9 (256^2). 172 persistent splits with 0 merges, 8 ringed lineages that swim >= 3 BL and divide, contour ring median 1.59; labkit's aggregate ring is 1.38, below the gate as stated; chi=0 goes extinct
summary: I ran c28's world (WORLD_P drive=kernel, mu=0.75, kd=0.08) on fresh seed 9 at 256^2. labkit pack (t=10000): a bounded population of ringed cells forms from noise (sheet t=0-850), with 123 persistent splits, max generation 7 and only 16 merges (merge/split 0.04). 182 tracks move >= 1 body length (max 4.2). Aggregate L rim/core is 1.38 with 187/427 individuals membrane-like, below the 1.5 gate, as c28 reports (1.36-1.38). c28's ringtrack.py to t=20000: 172 persistent splits, 0 merges, generation 6, 82 tracks >= 3 body lengths; contour ring score median 1.589 with 87.7% of 28617 scored cell-frames >= 1.5. lineage_report.py finds 8 lineages that swim >= 3 BL ringed and divide into ringed daughters (e.g. #461: 3.92 BL, ring 1.57, children ring 1.62). chi=0 on seed 9 (pack_chi0): 0 cells by t~3000.

observations.I: pack/sheet.png t=850-10000: discrete round and crescent cells
observations.M: data/k256_s9.report.txt: 81 tracks swim >= 3 BL, 80 of them ringed in >= half their frames
observations.D: data/k256_s9.report.txt: 172 persistent splits, 0 merges, generation 6; 8 swim-ring-divide lineages

seeds_run.result: pass: replicates splits, clean tree, ring median 1.59, aggregate ring 1.38, chi=0 extinct

controls_run.B: pack_chi0 (chi=0, seed 9): all cells gone by t~3000

not_checked: B: the finding itself says B is not established with this drive (aggregate 1.38); I agree
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. Small cells are often unscored by the contour ring score, so the 87.7% figure is over scored frames only.
